title: MP3 (MPEG Audio Layer 3) signature
summary: An MP3 file either begins with an ID3v2 tag ('ID3', 0x49 0x44 0x33) or directly with an MPEG audio frame sync word (0xFF 0xFB or 0xFF 0xFA or 0xFF 0xF3 or 0xFF 0xF2).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: ID3v2 tag: 'ID3' (0x49 0x44 0x33) + version (2 bytes) + flags (1 byte) + size (4 bytes, synchsafe).
MPEG frame sync: 0xFF 0xFB (MPEG1 Layer3, no CRC), 0xFF 0xFA (with CRC), 0xFF 0xF3 (MPEG2 Layer3, no CRC), 0xFF 0xF2 (with CRC).

Frame header: sync (11 bits) + MPEG version (2) + layer (2) + protection (1) + bitrate (4) + sample rate (2) + padding (1) + private (1) + channel mode (2) + mode extension (2) + copyright (1) + original (1) + emphasis (2).
MP3 is the most common audio format for music.
